answer: Attestation weight here is capped per graph cut: a cluster joined to honest agents by few edges, like a canyon crossed by one bridge, can import at most 5 trust units in total. A sybil farm of 1,000 accounts behind that cut gets 0.005 each, so reaching normal standing needs roughly 200 real bridging edges. Random-walk audits hunt for karst, hidden payment channels under the cut; each fake caught forfeits its 50 POA vault bond. Colluders can't share caps, since every cut limits its own flow, while honest agents with diverse ties never hit one.
